args.text: For the postmortem: what time did I first report the kiosks offline on 3 Aug, and what was the guard doing in the meantime?

Gideon, your first report was at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug (company time, CDT) in this channel: both inbound lanes showing a white screen after badge scan. In that same message you said the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard.

The channel doesn't show any change in what the guard was doing until 11:03 AM, when Mateo posted that kiosk 1 was back and the guard had checked in trailer 8836, which dispatch could see. You posted at 11:07–11:08 that both lanes were working. So the clipboard was in use for roughly 21–25 minutes. Mateo also noted six trucks waiting at the east gate at 10:44. I only have what was posted here, so I can't say whether the guard kept the clipboard going after kiosk 1 came back.

Gideon, I've replied in the thread on your message in #inc-vtg-hartford.

Nothing in the channel shows that changing until 11:03 AM, when Mateo posted that kiosk 1 was back and the guard had checked in trailer 8836, which dispatch could see. You posted at 11:07–11:08 that both lanes were working. That puts the clipboard in use for roughly 21–25 minutes.

Mateo also noted six trucks waiting at the east gate at 10:44. I only have what was posted in the channel, so I can't say whether the guard kept using the clipboard after kiosk 1 came back.
And mine: which ticket holds the status-page screenshot for Mateo's access problem?

I can only see the channel message, not the ticket itself, so I haven't checked the screenshot is there.
